regressions.issue: Variables that held the free-memory pointer at an allocation are replaced by the pointer's full symbolic value, a sum of every earlier allocation's size. Array bases and decoded words become 5-10 term sums. 315 lines now exceed 240 characters (old 35), and the text grew 27% in bytes (565 KB -> 718 KB) while losing 2% of its lines.
regressions.rule: Keep a variable for the value mem[64] held when an object was allocated (its base), and print addresses as base + constant. Substitute the symbolic value of mem[64] only where it is a constant or a single term.
regressions.verified: text_check run --per-selector 16: 195/195 same in both worlds (readability only)

regressions.issue: Inside the loop, the store at _141 (the old mem[64]) is no longer proven disjoint from the hash scratch words. The mapping read stays raw sha3(mem[0 len 64]) on the line right after the same value prints as stor265[stor257[s]].length, and element 0 and the copy source lose the mapping. sha3(mem[..]) lines 10 -> 18.
regressions.rule: mem[64] keeps the floor 0x80 through loop headers and joins (every store to it writes a constant >= 0x80 or mem[64] plus a non-negative size). So a store at mem[64] + k never overlaps mem[0..63]: forward the scratch words into the sha3 and print the mapping access.

new_findings.issue: The Error(string) revert is decoded only for its last word, as 100 raw memory bytes followed by a constant. The same revert reads 'TransferHelper::safeTransfer: transfer failed' in _externalSell, externalRebalance, enablePrimaryTokens and enableAndUpdatePrimaryTokens.
new_findings.rule: When every word of the revert data is a known stored value, decode the whole Error(string) payload, not only the words written after the last unresolved store.

improvements: Many calls gain names and decoded args: setPaused, getTokens, tokenRegistry, vault, totalSupply, updateRecords, balanceOf, and delegate library calls as unknownXXXXXXXX(?) with Array(..) args. Raw-memory call lines 217 -> 160. Three TransferHelper reverts and the custom error 0x479e9def are decoded. getSwapData returns 'Array(..), Array(..)' instead of raw memory, so one encoding loop is gone. P6 21 -> 0 and P4 7 -> 0. The safeTransfer payload copy loops have the constant bound 68.
notes: Diff 6822 lines, reviewed by structure. A per-function comparison of calls, logs, storage writes, reverts, returns and whiles found the same sequences in every changed function apart from names and decoded reverts; 4544c93d/ec0ddfcd only show the difflib alignment of repeated blocks. The control skeletons (if/else/while/call/log/return) match line for line in all 10 functions; only conditions and names differ. Read in full: getSwapData, getCurrentWeights, externalRebalance, revertEnableRebalancing (ByUser has the same changes), and the enableAndUpdatePrimaryTokens loop over the calldata address[] (now bounded by cd[_param1 + 4] instead of mem[128], which held it). Regression 1 is the dominant effect of the new free-memory-pointer tracking on this contract: in c00204 it removed raw memory, here it mostly lengthens addresses.
summary: No semantic change (text_check 195/195), but readability regressed. Allocation bases are substituted by long sums (571 lines with >= 4 ceil32 terms, +27% bytes), redeemedAmounts reads in the two revertEnableRebalancing functions fall back to sha3(mem[0 len 64]), and 7 call targets became raw memory slices. Improvements: many calls and reverts now named or decoded, P6/P4 gone, P2 217 -> 160.
